reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: Давно хотела попробовать эти патчи я в восторге очень классные использую практически каждый день. Использую как маску как салфетки как Toner я люблю когда они прохладные поэтому банку храню в холодильнике очень классно освежает и охлаждает лицо после улицы
reviews.zh: 好耐之前就想試吓呢啲水精華棉片，超鍾意，真係好正，幾乎日日都用。可以當面膜用、當濕紙巾用、當爽膚水用。我鍾意凍凍地嘅感覺，所以成罐擺喺雪櫃，由外面返嚟用嚟鎮靜同降溫皮膚真係一流。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I’ve been loving the SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pads! They feel incredibly soothing and hydrating on my skin, especially when it’s feeling sensitive or irritated. The pads are soft, well-soaked, and leave my skin feeling refreshed, calm, and moisturized without any stickiness. A great addition to my skincare routine for a quick boost of hydration and comfort.
reviews.zh: 我一直好鍾意 SKINFOOD 胡蘿蔔素鎮靜水精華棉片！喺皮膚上用嘅時候感覺超級舒緩同保濕，特別係當皮膚敏感或者受刺激嘅時候。棉片柔軟、滲透度高，用完皮膚感覺清爽、平靜同水潤，唔會有黏笠感。對我嘅護膚程序嚟講係好幫手，可以快速補充水分同舒適感。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I love love love this! Maybe it’s just me but every time I use this pad my redness fades fast, breakouts and just overall skin looks better. There’s no smell other than the ingredients. And no irritation perfect for combination skin and feels hydrating after!
reviews.zh: 我勁鍾意勁鍾意勁鍾意呢個！可能只係我嘅感覺，但每次用完塊棉片，泛紅會好快退，爆瘡同整體膚況都會好轉。除咗成分本身之外冇咩味道。亦冇刺激，混合性肌膚用啱晒，用完仲好保濕！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I had been seeing this everywhere and decided to purchase it. I have repurchased it twice since. It's a great toner pad that you can use day or night - not too thick but also not too light in essence texture. The pad itself is thicker than mediheal or biodance. It feels more cotton-round like. It's hydrating and feels soft on the skin. Definitely recommend if you're on the fence or have been wanting to try it out!
reviews.zh: 周圍都見到呢個產品，所以決定買嚟試吓。之後已經回購咗兩次。係好好用嘅爽膚棉片，日夜都用得——精華質地唔算厚但都唔算薄。棉片本身比 Mediheal 同 Biodance 厚身，似化妝棉多啲。保濕度高，搽喺皮膚上好柔軟。如果你仲喺度猶豫緊或者一直想試，絕對推薦！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: One of the best toner pads I have. So moisturizing and soaked with goodness! The texture of the pads are also very different with other brands. Its waffle texture allows more product to soak on the pad and it usually takes longer for my skin to absorb compared to other brands. Love how my skin feels after using it. My fav!
reviews.zh: 係我用過最好嘅爽膚棉片之一。超級保濕，精華滿滿！棉片質地同其他品牌好唔同。佢嘅窩夫格紋可以承載更多精華，皮膚吸收嘅時間亦都比起其他品牌耐。用完之後皮膚嘅觸感我好鍾意。我嘅最愛！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text:
I’ve heard mix reviews about this one but in my opinion I really like it for calming/soothing/hydrating. 

I think there are other options as well to get the same results but this one I like because you can peel them in half and get a 2 for 1 almost. There’s a lot of product and it stretches very nice.

I like using it for redness specifically.
reviews.zh:
我聽過關於呢個嘅評價好壞參半，但喺我睇法，佢喺鎮靜／舒緩／保濕方面真係好好用。

我覺得有其他選擇都可以達到同樣效果，但呢個我鍾意係因為可以撕開一半，變相一變二。精華含量高，仲可以拉到好長。

我特別鍾意用佢嚟對付泛紅。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text:
Tengo piel sensible y mixta y justo estaba buscando unas Toner Pads que fueran amigables con mi piel porque suele irritanse mucho en el área de la barbilla. LAS AMO, justo son lo que estaba buscando. Se sienten tan bien en mi piel, calman el picor y las rojeces en mis mejillas. Huelen a tierra, pero eso es lo de menos. 
Traen un refill de 30 Pads de regalo.
reviews.zh:
我係敏感性混合肌，一直喺搵一啲適合自己皮膚嘅爽膚棉片，因為我下巴位成日都好容易敏感。我超級鍾意呢個，啱啱就係我要搵嘅。搽上皮膚感覺好舒服，可以舒緩臉頰嘅痕癢同泛紅。有陣泥土味，但呢啲唔係重點。
附送30片裝補充裝一份。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Calming Water Pad 60 Pads (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I don’t recommend it. It made my face so red and swollen right after using it. I can’t even refund it even if it doesn’t work on my face.
reviews.zh: 唔推薦。用完之後即刻成塊面又紅又腫。就算對我嚟講冇用，連退款都唔得。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
